reveal_en: Our planet continuously vibrates with a deep, inaudible hum. It’s a constant, subtle symphony of seismic waves always moving.
reveal_zh: 我们的星球持续发出深沉、人耳听不见的嗡鸣。这是地震波奏响的无形交响。
meaning_en: This constant vibration reveals Earth as a living, dynamic entity. A powerful, unseen force quietly shapes our world beneath our feet.
meaning_zh: 这持续的震动揭示地球是一个鲜活的、动态的实体。一股强大、无形的力量正悄然塑造着我们的世界。

visual.color: Subtle deep blue and purple gradient, with faint green undertones
visual.motion: Slow, barely perceptible ripple effect, like liquid, emanating from the center. Faint, pulsing light.
